name: Integrative Biology and Physiology PhD
summary: Research PhD in integrative biology and physiology.
detailsNote: Official available requirements. December 1 is published without a year; Fall 2027 deadline not confirmed. Funding amounts have no stated academic year unless noted; confirm offer. Admission model omitted unless directly established.

english.toefl: 79 with W21/R19 before January 21, 2026; 4.5 total/W/R on or after
english.note: IELTS reading/writing 6.5; Fall 2027 DET total/reading/writing 120. Scores within two years of start. Twin Cities does not accept TOEFL MyBest; IELTS One Skill Retake is not accepted. Education exemption: secondary school in US/listed country, or 16 semester/24 quarter non-ESL postsecondary credits completed within past two years while living in US/listed country. Program may require higher scores.

applicationFee.note: US citizen/PR $75, international $95; nonrefundable. Central office does not waive fees. GSDO conditional route: US citizen/PR seeking first graduate degree with qualifying listed participation; request before submission/payment. Medical School may offer limited domestic waivers; confirm program procedure.

documents: Diversity statement and research description (optional, but described as expected)
requirements.note: Undergraduate degree, including one year calculus, physics and biology, two years chemistry; exceptions possible by contact. GRE not required/expected and not evaluated. Fall PhD only; no MS. Personal statement covers research experience, technical skills, challenges and fit; faculty contact optional.

funding.note: Undated offer description: $37,481/year ($36.04/hour), full tuition, health/dental benefits and many fees. Most students apply for independent support in second/third year. Confirm written duration and international terms.
